items.title: Verstappen wins in Mexico City as Antonelli clinches the title
items.summary: Verstappen started fifth after his qualifying lock-up and Lawson incident, then used Ferrari's opening-lap battle to take his third win of 2026. Hamilton finished 0.799s behind. Antonelli took third and secured his maiden Drivers' Championship.
items.why_it_matters: Lead with the title and the Ferrari win that got away. The published session table still shows the pre-penalty order, so quote Alpine and McLaren positions with care.

items.title: Hamilton and Leclerc's opening-lap clash costs Ferrari victory
items.summary: The pair tangled at Turn 4 while fighting for the lead. Leclerc passed Hamilton off track and was penalised; he now says the penalty was deserved. Hamilton says Ferrari had a P1-P2 car and wants serious talks. Vasseur called it a matter of respect.
items.why_it_matters: This is the main Ferrari storyline into Brazil. Report the quotes as the drivers' and team principal's own views, not as a confirmed change of team-order policy.

items.title: Piastri's 10s penalty and Alpine's yellow-flag penalties reshuffle the points
items.summary: Piastri received a 10-second penalty for the collision with Lindblad and lost seventh. Colapinto and Gasly then lost their finishes for separate yellow-flag infringements, leaving Alpine without points. Mercedes was also fined because Russell skipped the media pen.
items.why_it_matters: Use the final post-penalty classification, not the earlier chequered-flag order. The exact revised order and updated standings were not available when this briefing was reviewed.

items.title: Russell's opening-lap deployment problem costs him a shot at victory
items.summary: Russell missed pole by 0.009s and made a quick start. A deployment problem on the opening lap cancelled that out, and he finished sixth for eight points. Teammate Antonelli took the title with third place.
items.why_it_matters: It separates Mercedes' title celebration from Russell's lost opportunity, and it is an open reliability and deployment question for Brazil.
